turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Cloud demand was strong and AI adoption across Copilot is accelerating. We are increasing capital expenditure to meet AI compute demand.
Revenue grew 16% year over year. Azure growth was strong. Capital expenditure rose to support data center investment. We expect cloud demand to stay healthy.
How should we think about capex and cloud optimization?
Capital expenditure will remain elevated for data center investment. Some customers continue cloud optimization but demand is robust.
